audits.text:
## da9e4535a458

**Reproduced defect — declared exact-control domain is not callable.** Generator
SHA-256 is
`491211606fd31a1bab0d7946728957a53e5de1fba3e3d40b270df1d1a00d8a43`.
`AXES["grid_h"]` declares `10..16`, but
`generate(seed=0, sample_index=0, difficulty="easy", grid_h=14)` raises
`ValueError: draw_int('grid_h'): override 14 outside [11, 12]`. No
`INCOMPATIBLE_OVERRIDE_COMBINATIONS` declaration explains the conflict.

The minimal source-hash-bound reproducer is
`checks/audit/da9e4535a458/contract_repro.json`. The supported override gate was
also run from the packet root and exited 1; its receipt and detailed grouped
failures are retained at `checks/audit/da9e4535a458-override/`. It additionally
reports many multi-axis rejections and singleton/dead controls.

Impact: a curriculum controller cannot trust the public axis schema to request
legal banded examples, so coverage claims based on the advertised domain are
false. This is a generator contract defect, not evidence that the Racket labels
for ordinary default samples are wrong. The source-hash-bound scan receipt at
`checks/audit/default-self-check-scan.json` covers seeds 0–1,999 in each of the
default/easy/medium/hard bands (8,000 draws total) and found 0 `self_check`
failures, but that does not repair the explicit override mismatch. Audit-only;
no source was changed.

triage.reason: Accepted source-bound findings-only audits; exact reproductions retained. Generator contract/teaching defects are repair candidates, no-issue outcomes remain bounded; duplicates do not count as new defects.
